query get {
  fulfillments(order_by: {created_at: desc}) {
    id
    name
    display_name
    thumbnail_logo
    large_logo
    description
    detail_url
    badge_text
    badge_color
    position
    active
    exportable
    large_logo
    created_at
    updated_at
    user_fulfillments {
      id
      api_key
      api_secret
      forwarding_shipping_method
      config
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
